#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll mod_plus(ll a, ll b) {
    ll c = a + b;
    if (c >= MOD) c -= MOD;
    return c;
}

ll mod_minus(ll a, ll b) {
    ll c = a - b;
    if (c < 0) c += MOD;
    return c;
}

ll mod_times(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll c = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) c = (c * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return c;
}

ll mod_div(ll a, ll b) {
    return mod_times(a, mod_pow(b, MOD - 2));
}

ll mod_comb(int n, int k, const vector<ll>& facts) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
    return mod_div(facts[n], mod_times(facts[k], facts[n - k]));
}

vector<ll> mod_factorials(int n) {
    vector<ll> f(n + 1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }
    return f;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    ll kt;
    cin >> n >> kt;

    if (kt >= n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    int k = (int)kt;
    vector<ll> facts = mod_factorials(n);

    ll ans = 0;
    int c = n - k;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        ll t = mod_times(mod_comb(c, i, facts), mod_pow(c - i, n));
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = mod_plus(ans, t);
        } else {
            ans = mod_minus(ans, t);
        }
    }
    ans = mod_times(ans, mod_comb(n, n - k, facts));

    if (k > 0) ans = mod_times(ans, 2);
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
